question.text: The perimeter of the rectangle $LMNP$ above equals $22\, \mathrm{cm}.$ What is the length of $\overline{NP}?$
question.explanation:
The opposite sides of a rectangle are congruent, so we have

\[ PL=MN=3\, \mathrm{cm}. \]

For the same reason, we also have

\[ NP = LM. \]

Now, since the perimeter is $p=22 \, \textrm{cm},$ we have

\begin{align*} p &= LM+MN+NP+PL \\[3pt] 22 &= 2NP+2PL \\[3pt] 22 &= 2NP + 6 \\[3pt] 16 &= 2NP \\[3pt] 8 &= NP \,. \end{align*}

Therefore, $NP = 8 \, \textrm{cm}.$

question.explanation:
If $PQRS$ is a square, then $m\angle QSP=45^{\circ}.$ Now, we have

\begin{align} m\angle QSP &= 45^\circ\\[3pt] (2t+7)^\circ &= 45^\circ\\[3pt] 2t &=38 \\[3pt] t &=19. \end{align}

example.title: Finding the Measure of a Diagonal of a Square

The diagonals of a square are equal and bisect each other. So we have
